_note: Masks (polish1 D5c, diary/DECISIONS_SKINS.md + diary/MASK_PROCESS.md). Each mask: name, source (boss / elite / loot / playtime / achievement), base shape, covers (full = the character's hair, brows, eyes and head wear are left off under it), trade (drop masks trade), model = assets/masks/<id>/ made by tools/blender/mask_bake.py, fx = the game's own effects. Morse messages are the director's to rewrite. detail = per graphics tier (potato .. ultimate): mesh hi / lo, textures full / half, effects share.

drops._note: chance per player: boss kill -> a boss mask, elite kill -> an elite mask (both rolled by the host / a lone player), colosseum end chest -> a loot mask; the mask is any of that source's masks (director 2026-11-21: B, any boss can drop any boss mask)

plague_doctor.name: Plague Doctor
plague_doctor.text: Aged leather, a 17th-century hat and a hooked beak. The eyes flash messages in Morse code; a green death cloud and flies drift from the beak.

iron_reaper.name: Iron Reaper
iron_reaper.text: A heavy industrial skull welded from steel plates. Molten eyes glow behind visor slats; the jaw grinds on its pistons and sheds sparks and shavings.

venom_sovereign.name: Venom Sovereign
venom_sovereign.text: A king cobra's head with its hood flared. The slit eyes blink one at a time, the forked tongue flicks out, and glowing venom drips from the fangs.

ashen_king.name: Ashen King
ashen_king.text: A scowling porcelain face charred black under a crown of ceramic spikes, a chunk of one cheek broken away and fire inside. Its cracks heal and split again, ash rises off the crown, and the embers burn brighter while the wearer stands still.

blood_eclipse.name: Blood Eclipse
blood_eclipse.text: A smooth black lacquer face with a knife-edge brow and slit eyes burning faint red. On its forehead a red eclipse turns slowly inside a glowing ring that breathes out a red haze; blade fins sweep back from the temples.
